name: Manny Wenas Featured Slider
author: mannywenas

sections.description:
Manny Wenas Featured Slider displays your featured posts in a full-width hero slider with a thumbnail strip for navigation. No dependencies, no jQuery, no bloat.

Features:

  • Full-width hero image with text overlay (title, excerpt, byline)
  • Thumbnail strip navigation — position top, bottom, left, or right
  • Auto-advance with configurable interval
  • Category filtering — show posts from specific categories or latest sitewide
  • Adjustable image ratio (16:9, 4:3, 3:2, 1:1, or custom dimensions)
  • Configurable slider width (20–100%)
  • Header bar with custom label text
  • Text overlay toggle (show/hide title, excerpt, byline)
  • Shortcode: [mwfeat]
  • Gutenberg block with per-block sidebar controls
  • Classic widget support
  • Zero external dependencies — vanilla JS only

Shortcode examples:

[mwfeat]
[mwfeat posts="8" auto="0"]
[mwfeat strip_position="left" show_text="0"]
[mwfeat header_label="Top Stories" show_header="1"]
[mwfeat category="tennis-news,draws-and-results"]
[mwfeat img_ratio="4:3" slider_width="80"]

Configure global defaults under Settings → Manny Wenas Slider.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the manny-wenas-featured-slider folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings → Manny Wenas Slider to configure your defaults
  4. Add the shortcode [mwfeat] to any post or page, or use the Gutenberg block, or add the widget to a widget area
sections.faq:
Does this work with any theme?

Yes. The slider is a standalone plugin and works with any WordPress theme.

How do I show only posts from specific categories?

Go to Settings → Manny Wenas Slider and tick the categories you want to include. You can also pass a category directly in the shortcode: [mwfeat category="your-category-slug"].

Can I use multiple sliders on one page?

Yes. Each shortcode or block instance renders independently with its own settings.

Does it work with the block editor (Gutenberg)?

Yes. There is a dedicated Gutenberg block under the Widgets category. Strip position, text overlay, and header settings are editable per-block from the sidebar Inspector panel.

Where do I set the number of slides and auto-advance speed?

Under Settings → Manny Wenas Slider. You can also override these per shortcode: [mwfeat posts="6" auto="5"].

What image size does it use?

The main slider uses the large image size. The thumbnail strip uses the thumbnail size. Both are standard WordPress image sizes.
